name: ShopifyProductSearch
description: Customer asks to find a product, whether one is in stock (online or at a store near them), or what it costs ('do you have air fryers', 'is this TV in stock in Phoenix', 'how much is the iPhone 16', '¿tienen refrigeradores?', '¿cuánto cuesta?'). Not: general advice without asking for a product (None); an order already placed (ShopifyTrackOrder); returns, shipping or other store policies (ShopifyStorePolicies). The product number is read by pickChoice, so a number with courtesy or a YES around it ("Yes 1", "1 please") picks it. On a call (owner 2026-10-17): the results are spoken — up to three, each with its name, price and stock, no links — and TEXT / TEXTO texts the links (text-destination, send-text), then the question is asked again; with no phone that can receive texts the TEXT option is not offered. The text ends with how to continue: by replying, and on WhatsApp (get-whatsapp-link, the search pre-filled) when the tenant invites callers there. A product number is a pick only when the tenant has store locations (global_store_locations), as the question offers it only then; otherwise a number is another request.
